method: Ran the new three-case Vitest content-contract suite and the existing 29-assertion historical/scorer audit. Compared all 12 displayed sample rows by date-order pattern, checked the explicitly stated teaching fixture contract, and reviewed current Anthropic stop-reason/thinking docs and the DeepSeek Anthropic-compatible endpoint guide. No model provider was called and historical runs were not replayed.
limitations: This verifies the current lesson text, its stated fixture contract, and source mapping; it does not recover the historical prompt, responses, scorer, or usage.
No date parser was implemented or executed; the contract makes the illustrative evaluation inputs unambiguous.
The new workflow is instructional design guidance and does not establish production rollout behavior.
No historical model run was replayed.

observations.trace: The four held-out input strings each have a corresponding broad format family in the eight extraction examples. Lesson now labels them as row-held-out only; gives a separate date contract; adds offline acceptance before review and controlled release; and no longer equates diluted aggregate impact with lack of rollback capability. Production build generated 408 static pages and Pagefind indexed 408 pages / 15,486 words. Light/dark full-page captures are 1300x10,847; document scroll width matches viewport, article width is 792px, and one Mermaid SVG rendered. The only initial browser error was favicon.ico 404.
